content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional payment infrastructure is built on a fragile foundation of intermediaries, middlemen, and gatekeepers. They dictate the terms of trade, control the flow of money, and often lock out creators from certain regions or countries. But what if you could bypass this middleman and establish a direct connection with your customers? The answer lies in a new kind of infrastructure, one that uses blockchain-based payments, Cloudflare, and Supabase to create a fully sovereign digital commerce stack. With this infrastructure, you can process payments, store and deliver your digital products, and connect with customers worldwide, all without relying on a traditional payment processor.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy this infrastructure, you'll need a few essential tools. First, you'll need a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, you'll need a backend logic service like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. You'll also need a database like Supabase or Google Sheets to store your orders. And finally, you'll need a payment processor like NOWPayments to handle your crypto transactions. With these tools in place, you can start building your digital commerce stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your tools in place, it's time to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. This involves integrating your payment processor with your hosting service and backend logic service. You'll also need to configure your database to store your orders and set up a delivery pipeline to get your digital products to customers. The key here is to automate as much of this process as possible, so you can focus on creating and marketing your digital products.
You can sell digital products to international buyers without Stripe or PayPal.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your payment and delivery pipeline set up, it's time to go live and start processing transactions. This involves configuring your NOWPayments account to accept crypto payments and integrating it with your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend logic service. You'll also need to test your payment flow to ensure it works smoothly. Once you've completed these steps, you can start processing transactions and delivering your digital products to customers worldwide.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The Edge Commerce Stack that COREMERCH deploys most frequently combines Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling and order processing, Supabase for order storage, Resend for transactional email delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. The total monthly cost is zero. The scale ceiling is significantly higher than what most individual creators need — Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 requests per day on the free tier, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage, and Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month. For a creator in any country on earth, this stack provides the same infrastructure as a well-funded e-commerce operation at no monthly cost.

Absolutely, you can sell digital products to international buyers without Stripe or PayPal. By using blockchain-based payments, Cloudflare, and Supabase, you can create a fully sovereign digital commerce stack that connects you directly with customers worldwide. And with tools like NOWPayments, you can accept crypto payments and process transactions in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.

If you're a digital creator in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, or beyond, you can use this infrastructure to sell digital products to international buyers and scale your business. You can find more information at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy this infrastructure, follow these steps: Set up a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Configure a backend logic service like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate a payment processor like NOWPayments with your hosting service. Configure your database to store orders. Set up a delivery pipeline to get digital products to customers. Test your payment flow to ensure it works smoothly. Configure your NOWPayments account to accept crypto payments. Integrate it with your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend logic service. Monitor your performance and optimize your pipeline as needed.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I use blockchain-based payments to accept crypto transactions?

You can use NOWPayments to accept crypto transactions in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. Simply configure your NOWPayments account to accept your preferred cryptocurrencies, and integrate it with your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend logic service.
What is a sovereign digital commerce stack, and how does it work?

A sovereign digital commerce stack is a fully independent infrastructure that connects you directly with customers worldwide. It uses blockchain-based payments, Cloudflare, and Supabase to process transactions, store orders, and deliver digital products. This infrastructure allows you to bypass traditional payment processors and intermediaries, giving you complete control over your digital commerce business.
Can I use this infrastructure to sell digital products in multiple currencies?

Yes, you can use this infrastructure to sell digital products in multiple currencies. Simply configure your NOWPayments account to accept your preferred currencies, and integrate it with your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend logic service. This will allow you to accept payments in different currencies and deliver digital products to customers worldwide.
How do I configure my NOWPayments account to accept crypto payments?

To configure your NOWPayments account to accept crypto payments, simply go to the NOWPayments dashboard, select your preferred cryptocurrencies, and configure the payment settings. Then, integrate it with your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend logic service to start processing transactions.
What are some benefits of using a sovereign digital commerce stack?

Some benefits of using a sovereign digital commerce stack include complete control over your digital commerce business, reduced fees, increased security, and scalability to handle thousands of transactions per day.
